brief: JPM's Oct 28 morning briefing centers the day on the 2pm FOMC decision, where JPM's own economists and consensus expect a hawkish hold; Feroli forecasts two hawkish dissents (Hammack, Logan) with a risk of a third (Kashkari), flags the optics problem of hiking after a two-tenths September core PCE print but holding after an expected three-tenths print, and expects Warsh to frame it as biased-to-hike-but-patient. Separately, JPM's TMT desk says AI financing hurdles are clearing (Meta's $97.5bn raise, SpaceX's $40bn GPU deal, Broadcom's $63bn custom-chip SPV), driving tentative re-risking in semis/optical even as Google is used as a funding source ahead of a feared Search miss. Energy desks report refiners suffering their largest drawdown since August, unwinding an unexplained prior-day crack move as Ukraine pauses strikes on Russian energy infrastructure and harvest's end frees Russian export supply. JPM's house view stays Tactically Bullish, citing on-track earnings (13% revenue, 30% EPS growth) and ~5% PMI growth against a 2-week SPX pullback into defensives, an incomplete positioning washout, and Middle East escalation risk; the factors desk separately calls the market's simultaneous pricing of a dovish Fed, geopolitical resolution and a self-funding AI capex upcycle low-probability.
